title: Climate, Resources, and Sustainable Consumption
summary: Climate policy, resource use, consumption, circular economy, and behavioral change.
whyItMatters: Sustainability decisions connect emissions, resource extraction, product design, infrastructure, behavior, and social fairness.

mentalModel.title: Follow the full life cycle
mentalModel.content: Consider production, transport, use, repair, reuse, and disposal.

mentalModel.title: Individual and structural action interact
mentalModel.content: Consumer choices depend on prices, infrastructure, regulation, and available alternatives.

ruleBlocks.title: Distinguish environmental impacts
ruleBlocks.content: Use Emissionen, Energieverbrauch, Rohstoffe, Flächenverbrauch, and Abfall precisely.

ruleBlocks.title: Analyze circular strategies
ruleBlocks.content: Compare vermeiden, reduzieren, wiederverwenden, reparieren, and recyceln.

ruleBlocks.title: Include distribution and feasibility
ruleBlocks.content: Ask who pays, who benefits, and which alternatives are accessible.

examples.de: Ein langlebiges Produkt kann Ressourcen sparen, sofern es tatsächlich lange genutzt wird.
examples.en: A durable product can save resources if it is actually used for a long time.

examples.de: Verbraucherentscheidungen lassen sich durch Preise und Infrastruktur beeinflussen.
examples.en: Consumer decisions can be influenced by prices and infrastructure.

examples.de: Eine Maßnahme ist nur dann nachhaltig, wenn ökologische und soziale Folgen berücksichtigt werden.
examples.en: A measure is sustainable only when ecological and social consequences are considered.

commonMistakes.wrong: Assume recycling alone solves resource use.
commonMistakes.correct: Prioritize avoidance, reduction, and reuse before recycling.
commonMistakes.reason: Material cycles still require energy and lose quality.

commonMistakes.wrong: Blame individuals without examining available options.

comparisons.summary: Policy and product language often expresses feasibility and necessity without canonical passive forms.
The communication lesson turns sustainability goals into criteria-based proposals.
